instruction: Set PXE boot via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password chassis bootdev pxe

instruction: Disable DNS from DHCP on NIC
Enable LAN access on channel 1 via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password lan set 1 access on

instruction: Enable SOL payload on channel 1 via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password sol payload enable 1 1

instruction: Set LAN channel 1 to static IP
Set channel access for user 2 via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password channel setaccess 1 2 link=on ipmi=on

instruction: List temperature sensors via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password sdr list temperature

instruction: Check server power status via racadm

output: ipmitool -H 192.168.1.100 -U root -P calvin chassis power status

instruction: Set SOL keep-alive flag via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password sol set 1 keep-alive-set
